theorems.name: Submission.bf_sphereGood_doubleCone_outerMeasure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ a : Rn N, ∃ m : OuterMeasure (Rn N), m {θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ ¬ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ a ∧ dist b a < δ ∧ H.starProjection (b - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (b - a)) θ • θ = 0} = 0 ∧ ∀ θ ∈ H, ‖θ‖ = 1 → ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < η → m ({ζ | ζ ∈ H ∧ ‖ζ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball θ t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * t ^ n)) → ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖H.starProjection (x - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (x - a)) θ • θ‖ < s * ‖H.starProjection (x - a)‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∧ ((∀ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < η ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * t ^ n) < m ({ζ | ζ ∈ H ∧ ‖ζ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball θ t)) → ∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖H.starProjection (x - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (x - a)) θ • θ‖ < s * ‖H.starProjection (x - a)‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)))
